notes.title: Construction Update V0.5.7
notes.content:
Construction is a big part of a city builder survival RPG game and I'm glad we have finally gotten here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757109/aa8b91da6f4ce56e16fb75b8f50c191eb32d78ea.png[/img]

A lot of work has gone into making the construction process for the buildings. This update brings the construction process to all of the primary buildings. There are still developer tools to allow for testing the process faster, but this update helps flesh out the gameplay of building your city. This system got streamlined down quite a few times while being developed and I am happy with the way it's working right now. One new dev tool that was added for this update is the instant build button located on the construction screen. The little green guy at the bottom left will finish your building without needing materials and can be used at any phase of the construction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757109/a91d936e3ab82fa7a0c67a949a7655c7356aa6fe.png[/img]

These past two updates contained a lot of new code. I hope you enjoy them!

notes.title: Item Stats Update
notes.content:
-NEW SAVE- Almost a major update with how much stuff went into the game these past two weeks. You now have leather to craft with, string is used and many crafted items have had a materials change. You can now throw rocks, no damage yet, but it is still as fun as it sounds. The map is working, the clothing and weapons now have stats on them and you can see the stats in the crafting menu. I added a pause game, x2 speed and improved the music button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757109/1bebab9f1ecb638a3e66c10157416dcc75abd6a9.png[/img]

This update is paving the way for more citizen jobs and more combat mechanics. This is a new save update so all your current progress will be lost. Unfortunately many of the upcoming versions will be new save updates because of modifying the save files. I hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Content Update
notes.content:
This update brings the functionality of the campfires, apple collection and item drops. You can now drop items from your inventory and your citizens will come pick them up and put them away for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757109/1c223056e499fb92d57aaf46ae55fec93cba2d25.png[/img]

Citizens will also gather apples for you now. Campfires use stick to stay lit and citizens will not gather around a campfire that goes out at night. Other fixes and changes inside. I hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Content Update
notes.content:
This is a fairly large update considering what all went into it. In game there are newer features like the campfires now burn through their inventory, if they go out the citizens won't be able to rest there at night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757109/1c223056e499fb92d57aaf46ae55fec93cba2d25.png[/img]

Citizens will now collect your apples for you as well as items you drop from your inventory. Character movement has been modified, I wish I could say improved.. it runs smother but still has some issues.

notes.title: Inventory Update
notes.content: This is a much needed update that adds the ability to move items in the inventory by double clicking on them. This also added a lot of improvements to the inventory logic and a few of the menus. In order for this update to work a bunch of the citizen code was modified and while I was at it the citizens can now wear shoes.

notes.title: Woodcutter Update
notes.content: The citizens have ben updated with a new profession: the Woodcutter. This option created a whole new set of issues in the code and it took what seemed like forever to sort them out. Now you can assign the woodcutter task to your citizens provide them with an axe and a woodshed and they will get to work clearing the forest for you. The citizen rest state has been improved on with more to come.

notes.title: Version 0.4.9 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757109/c89750edfb54b3283920c111b790113458a04706.png[/img]

This update brings another building into the mix, the stockpile, this is a small and cheap structure that can store anything. Citizens can now interact with these structures and chose which items should go to these structures first. For example, sticks will always be put in the stockpile first if there is room, leaving more room in your barns for fruit.
